status: G3 pilot: processed, compressed and reviewed; in the game at the Overview camera of Chapters IV and VII (desktop build, High)
use: An officers' tent beside the commander's place, beyond the board.

generator.prompt: A Roman officer's tent for a field camp: a large rectangular tent of stitched brown goatskin with low upright walls and a pitched roof on two poles and a ridge pole, its front flaps tied open under a small porch awning on two poles, guy ropes running to wooden pegs, a folding camp stool at the entrance. Patched and weathered leather. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
